cards.ex: With the economy slowing down, we all need to tighten our belts a bit.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiyot sekinlashar ekan, hammamiz ozgina tejamkor bo'lishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish, pulni tejash, qattiq rejimda yashash.

cards.ex: It's hard to make ends meet on a part-time job these days.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi kunda yarim kunlik ish bilan kun ko'rish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Daromad va xarajatlarni tenglashtirish, yetarli pul topish.

cards.ex: Our business has been in the red for the last two quarters.
cards.exUz: Bizning biznesimiz oxirgi ikki chorakda qarzda bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qarzda bo'lish, bank hisobida minusda bo'lish.

cards.ex: After years of struggle, the company is finally in the black.
cards.exUz: Yillar davomidagi kurashlardan so'ng, kompaniya nihoyat foydaga kirdi.
cards.uzDef: Foyda ko'rish, bank hisobida pul bo'lish.

cards.ex: Don't worry, buying lunch here won't break the bank.
cards.exUz: Xavotirlanmang, bu yerda tushlik sotib olish sizni bankrot qilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p pul sarflash, moliyaviy ahvolni buzish.

cards.ex: My parents footed the bill for my college education.
cards.exUz: Ota-onam kollej ta'limim uchun to'lovni to'lashdi.
cards.uzDef: To'lovni o'z zimmasiga olmoq, xarajatlarni qoplamoq.

cards.ex: They're hoping to build a nest egg for retirement.
cards.exUz: Ular nafaqaga chiqish uchun jamg'arma yig'ishga umid qilishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Keksalik uchun yig'ilgan pul, jamg'arma.

cards.ex: The company's cash flow is healthy right now.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning pul oqimi hozirda sog'lom.
cards.uzDef: Pulning kirishi va chiqishi, moliyaviy harakat.

cards.ex: I had to shell out a lot of money for car repairs.
cards.exUz: Men mashinani ta'mirlash uchun ko'p pul to'lashga majbur bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p pul sarflash, katta miqdorda to'lovni amalga oshirish.

cards.ex: Many people are living paycheck to paycheck these days.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar hozirgi kunda oylikdan oylikkacha yashashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Oylikdan oylikkacha yashash, pulni tejab bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: Since his company went public, he's been rolling in it.
cards.exUz: Uning kompaniyasi ommaviy bo'lganidan beri, u juda boy bo'lib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda boy bo'lish, pulga to'lib toshish.

cards.ex: We managed to travel Europe on a shoestring budget.
cards.exUz: Biz Yevropani juda kam byudjet bilan sayohat qila oldik.
cards.uzDef: Juda kam pul bilan ish qilish, tejamkorlik bilan yashash.

cards.ex: He made a killing in the stock market last year.
cards.exUz: U o'tgan yili fond bozorida katta foyda ko'rdi.
cards.uzDef: Tezda katta foyda ko'rish, pul topish.

cards.ex: Don't be such a cheapskate, buy us a round of drinks!
cards.exUz: Bunchalik xasis bo'lmang, bizga bir stakan ichimlik sotib oling!
cards.uzDef: Juda xasis odam, hech narsaga pul sarflamaydigan odam.

cards.ex: I'm trying to pay off all my student loans, so I'm in debt.
cards.exUz: Men barcha talabalik kreditlarimni to'lashga harakat qilyapman, shuning uchun qarzdorman.
cards.uzDef: Qarzi bo'lish, pulga muhtoj bo'lish.

cards.ex: Be careful borrowing money from loan sharks; they can be dangerous.
cards.exUz: Sudxo'rlardan pul olishda ehtiyot bo'ling; ular xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori foizlarda qarz beruvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: The government provided a bailout to the failing bank.
cards.exUz: Hukumat bankrot bo'layotgan bankka moliyaviy yordam ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Moliyaviy qiyinchilikda bo'lgan kompaniyaga yordam.

cards.ex: Remember, a penny saved is a penny earned, so try to save where you can.
cards.exUz: Unutmang, tejaganim topganim, shuning uchun imkon qadar tejashga harakat qiling.
cards.term: a penny saved is a penny earned
cards.uzDef: Tejash pul topish bilan teng, tejash muhim.

cards.ex: After losing his job, he was living on the breadline.
cards.exUz: Ishdan bo'shatilgandan so'ng, u qashshoqlikda yashay boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kambag'al bo'lish, qashshoqlik chegarasida yashash.

cards.ex: I'm not buying you that expensive toy; money doesn't grow on trees!
cards.exUz: Men senga bu qimmatbaho o'yinchoqni sotib olmayman; pul osmondan tushmaydi!
cards.uzDef: Pulni topish oson emas, uni qadrlash kerak.

cards.ex: I had to fork out a fortune to get my car fixed.
cards.exUz: Mashinamni tuzatish uchun juda ko'p pul to'lashimga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa uchun ko'p pul to'lash.

cards.ex: Her family is loaded; they own half the businesses in town.
cards.exUz: Uning oilasi juda boy; ular shahardagi bizneslarning yarmini egalik qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda boy, puli ko'p.

cards.ex: After getting her bonus, she went on a spending spree.
cards.exUz: U bonus olganidan so'ng, xarajatlar ketma-ketligiga tushib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p pul sarflash, xarajat qilish.

cards.ex: They try to nickel and dime their employees by cutting benefits.
cards.exUz: Ular xodimlarga nafaqalarni qisqartirish orqali arzon narxga tushirishga harakat qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Arzon narxga tushirish, kichik miqdordagi pulni tejash.

cards.ex: I decided to cash in my stock options before they expired.
cards.exUz: Muddati tugashidan oldin aksiyadorlik variantlarimni naqdlashtirishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Pulga aylantirmoq, naqd pul olmoq.

cards.ex: I try to set aside a little money each month for emergencies.
cards.exUz: Men har oy favqulodda vaziyatlar uchun ozgina pul ajratishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum maqsad uchun pul ajratmoq.

cards.ex: He bought an expensive car he couldn't afford. A fool and his money are soon parted.
cards.exUz: U o'zi to'lay olmaydigan qimmat mashina sotib oldi. Ahmoq puli tez tugaydi.
cards.term: A fool and his money are soon parted
cards.uzDef: Ahmoq odamlar pulni tezda yo'qotadi.

cards.ex: She came into money when her grandfather passed away.
cards.exUz: U bobosi vafot etganida pulga ega bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmaganda pulga ega bo'lish, meros olish.

cards.ex: I don't make much money, but I get by.
cards.exUz: Men ko'p pul topmayman, lekin kun kechiraman.
cards.uzDef: Kam pul bilan kun kechirish, omon qolish.

cards.ex: That money is burning a hole in my pocket; I need to go shopping.
cards.exUz: Bu pul cho'ntagimni kuydirmoqda; men xarid qilishim kerak.
cards.term: burn a hole in your pocket
cards.uzDef: Pulingiz bo'lishi bilan uni sarflash istagi.
